segment_captions.caption: C speaks directly to the camera, gesturing with her hands while wearing a black top with white trim. Her hair is tied back in a braid. The background shows a closet with clothes hanging inside.
C holds a hairbrush and brushes her hair while speaking.
C speaks while gesturing with both hands, then lowers her hands slightly.
C speaks with hands raised, then lowers them slightly while continuing to speak.
